items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: I think — oh in the beginning I went on the road with a lot of singers, you know, Betty Carter — for some reason Betty Carter always knew the new pianists when they came in town, and there was the Dakota Staton, Al Hibbler, Joe Williams

ctx.x: Did you have to work a day job, like to get by?

No because you do a lot of jobs as sideman and then what happens certain people hear you and start spreading your name around. And they said, “Oh man, we’ve got this new kid in town, plays piano, he sounds pretty good.” Then you start getting calls. I think — oh in the beginning I went on the road with a lot of singers, you know, Betty Carter — for some reason Betty Carter always knew the new pianists when they came in town, and there was the Dakota Staton, Al Hibbler, Joe Williams, and then, you know I got a…
You know I saw Rahsaan in probably 1968 or 9, and what a force of nature he was.
